// Fixture for scripts/test-scripts.sh (poll-check): stored as .txt so the tree's
// Go tools never compile it. An in-process condition is polled with no marker.
package zzpollprobe

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/ianglennon/tierplan/proto/testsupport"
)

func TestPollsWithoutAMarker(t *testing.T) {
	done := false
	testsupport.WaitFor(t, "the flag to be set", func() bool { return done })
}
